name: LABBench2
intro: LABBench2 是 LAB-Bench 的高保真后继基准，包含 1,912 行开放式生物学研究评测数据，覆盖文献理解与检索、数据访问、分子生物学、实验方案排错和实验规划。任务数据在 Hugging Face 自动门控，评测框架与 GCS 外部附件公开；官方评测比较无工具系统和以网络搜索、代码执行为主的工具增强系统。
build_method: 六条独立任务构建路线：专家文献编写、系统综述提取、LLM 与专家混合选源、程序化序列变体、专家注错实验方案，以及论文仅披露任务合同的克隆规划
metric: Overall Accuracy, Attempted Accuracy, 五类 HybridEvaluator 二元评分, 官方榜单十五个子基准宏平均
modality: 文本, 图像, PDF, 数据文件, 生物序列
task_type: 开放式生命科学研究任务, Agent 任务
eval_feature: 真实检索与文件输入, 逐题 mode 支持, 工具增强, 按 tag 路由的 LLM 与确定性验证器
scale: 1,912 行评测数据 / 5 类科研能力 / 15 个子基准配置 + all
modality_en: Text, image, PDF, data files, biological sequences
task_type_en: Open-response life-science research tasks, agent tasks
build_method_en: Six independent pipelines: expert literature authoring, systematic-review extraction, LLM-expert source selection, programmatic sequence variants, expert protocol error injection, and a cloning task contract whose construction provenance is not reported
eval_feature_en: Realistic retrieval and file inputs, item-level mode support, tool augmentation, tag-routed LLM and deterministic verifiers
intro_en: LABBench2 is the higher-fidelity successor to LAB-Bench. Its 1,912 open-response biology-research evaluation rows cover literature understanding and retrieval, data access, molecular biology, protocol troubleshooting, and experiment planning. Task Parquet is auto-gated on Hugging Face, while the evaluation harness and external GCS attachments are public; official evaluation compares systems without tools against systems augmented primarily with web search and code execution.
scale_en: 1,912 evaluation rows / 5 research-capability families / 15 sub-benchmark configs plus all
metric_en: Overall Accuracy, Attempted Accuracy, five-route HybridEvaluator binary scoring, official leaderboard macro-mean over fifteen sub-benchmarks

drawio_evidence_note: Primary evidence is arXiv:2604.09554v2, revised 2026-05-05; official Git revision c028ecdcf144b55ffcd92b68be45081df5628c20, committed 2026-05-07; Hugging Face dataset revision 27d12d72af24e3f70db8a99df63e567366cbdb80, last modified 2026-03-13; and the official Edison Labs leaderboard at https://labs.edisonscientific.com/benchmarks/labbench2/, checked 2026-07-21. The Git repository has no release tags, so the commit is the code snapshot boundary.
drawio_artifact_boundary_note: The pinned Hugging Face release contains all plus 15 sub-benchmark configurations and a single split literally named train with 1,912 evaluation rows. The Parquet task data is auto-gated and requires accepting contact-information sharing, while the evaluation harness and external PDFs, images, and bioinformatics files in the labbench2-data-public GCS bucket are public. The split name does not establish training use, and the paper reports no train/dev/test partition, deduplication, or contamination-control process. For CloningQA, the paper discloses the end-to-end task contract, three cloning-method families, output DSL, and in-silico validation, but not task-construction provenance or quality-control procedure.
drawio_release_drift_note: arXiv v1 and the OpenReview Archive Direct Upload describe 1,883 rows: PatentQA 122, TrialQA 121, SourceQuality 130, and FigQA2 variants 100/96/96. ArXiv v2 and the pinned dataset contain 1,912 rows with PatentQA 121, TrialQA 120, SourceQuality 150, and three FigQA2 variants of 101 each. On 2026-03-13 all 150 SourceQuality tasks were replaced after an inadvertent data issue, their harness mode changed from inject to file, and published reports were replaced. On 2026-03-23 Anthropic native-runner pause_turn and extended-thinking fixes again changed published results. The February Edison blog count of 1,892 and the Hugging Face card tag arxiv:2407.10362 refer to stale metadata and are not used as the current count source.
drawio_scoring_note: At Git c028ecdc the HybridEvaluator has five routes. LitQA3, PatentQA, TrialQA, SourceQuality, and ProtocolQA2 use a general semantic LLM judge. DbQA2 uses matched-expected recall, with numeric values normally accepted within plus or minus five percent and a correct threshold of recall at least 0.95. FigQA2, TableQA2, and SuppQA2 use a numeric LLM judge requiring absolute or relative difference below 1e-6 unless the question specifies formatting. SeqQA2 parses answer_regex inside answer tags and invokes a task-specific deterministic validator. CloningQA parses and executes the protocol DSL, requires reference-sequence similarity of at least 0.95 using one minus normalized Levenshtein distance with circular-rotation handling, and may add an enzyme-digest check. Incorrect, unsure, judge-error, parse-error, verifier-error, and runtime-failure outcomes score zero. Overall accuracy is correct divided by completed plus runtime failures; attempted accuracy is correct divided by completed. The live leaderboard separately macro-averages 15 sub-benchmark scores and restricts aggregate comparison to models covering at least 14 of 15.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.09554v2 and the pinned Git and Hugging Face revisions. The 1,912 evaluation rows comprise a 1,287-row literature family, DbQA2 86, SeqQA2 400, ProtocolQA2 125, and CloningQA 14. Six construction and quality-control pipelines remain separate: 1,137 non-SourceQuality literature rows are authored by PhD-level contractors and undergo contracted and internal multi-round source-fidelity review; SourceQualQA derives 150 rows from 100 open systematic reviews and manually checks final answerability; DbQA2 uses an LLM scan of 1,000 recent bioRxiv papers, manual curation and expert additions to reach 43 sources, then expert question writing and revision; SeqQA2 expands 20 in-house-biologist templates to 20 designed or real-sequence variants each; ProtocolQA2 uses public and expert-provided protocols with one unambiguous failure-causing error; and CloningQA is limited to the disclosed task and verifier contract because construction provenance is not reported. Figure and table variants, sequence modes, tag-routed scoring, release drift, artifact access, and the official leaderboard macro-aggregation are shown as distinct downstream stages rather than being folded into construction.
